description: Agent skills and plugin bundles from synapseradio/ai-skills: the thinkies reasoning toolkit, the visualizer chart skill, and the de-residency German-bureaucracy coach.
name: ai-skills

plugins.description: Reasoning toolkit of 57 skills — decomposition, questioning, assumption excavation, perspective shifts, decision analysis, ideation, synthesis, and epistemic integrity checks. Installed skills invoke as /thinkies:<name>.
plugins.name: thinkies

plugins.description: Conversational coach for non-EU expats preparing for German government appointments — visa, residency, citizenship. Researches every claim live and cites each factual statement with a URL.
plugins.name: de-residency

plugins.description: Turn data, a comparison, a trend, a flow, or a structure into a self-contained HTML chart page or a Markdown diagram, table, or text bars, checked before it is handed over. Installed skill invokes as /visualizer:visualize.
plugins.name: visualizer
